observations: Hot reload works only at the documented dev URL http://localhost:3000. At http://127.0.0.1:3000 Next.js blocks the dev HMR socket as cross-origin (allowedDevOrigins default) and the dev CSP allows ws://localhost:3000 only. The preview is unaffected. Not changed.
Editing src/i18n/messages.ts (a shared data module) makes Next.js reload the whole document (1.4 s, revert 1.8 s); component edits hot-swap in place.

The first two hot-reload attempts used http://127.0.0.1:3000 and timed out on the revert. The log's first explanation (same-second modification time) was wrong: a diagnostic showed the server recompiled every change (about 0.4 s) while the browser's HMR socket was refused. Recorded as a test-setup error, not product behaviour.
